package com.signpost.engine.model;

/**
 * The kind of thing a {@link Goal} represents, as produced by {@link com.signpost.engine.GapEngine}.
 * {@link #MILESTONE} covers gear/unlock/prayer/spellbook milestones; {@link #SLAYER_TARGET} and
 * {@link #BOSS} are their own categories. {@link #SKILL_TARGET} is a synthesised "<level>
 * <Skill>" goal ({@link com.signpost.engine.SkillTargetSynthesiser}).
 */
public enum GoalCategory
{
	QUEST,
	DIARY,
	MILESTONE,
	GEAR_UPGRADE,
	SLAYER_TARGET,
	BOSS,
	SKILL_TARGET
}

	public QuestState getState(Client client)
	{
		client.runScript(ScriptID.QUEST_STATUS_GET, id);
		switch (client.getIntStack()[0])
		{
			case 2:
				return QuestState.FINISHED;
			case 1:
				return QuestState.NOT_STARTED;
			default:
				return QuestState.IN_PROGRESS;
		}
	}
}
